newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent closes weaker as profit takers jump in.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent closes weaker as profit takers jump in.

text.p: IPE Brent crude closed down sharply on Thursday, having been dragged lower on gas oil-led profit-taking, brokers said.
Nov Brent ended just four cents above the session low at $23.58 a barrel, 69 cents down on Wednesday's close.
Despite losses, Brent outperformed gas oil, narrowing the Nov crack spread by $1 to $6.50 a barrel.
Frenetic selling deflated the Oct gas oil contract ahead of the it's expiry this morning after a scorching rally over the last two weeks took prices to five year highs.
Although this was six percent lower than a historical average, traders said the market was expecting a lower number.
After a brief uptick, the Brent market shrugged off reports from a Gulf source that OPEC had no plans to raise its crude output quota from the current 25.033 ceiling.
